title: sse: robust chunking/framing for SSE streaming (partial JSON, delimiter & token/event ordering fixes)
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Multiple customers and internal fuzzing surfaced intermittent JSON parse errors and truncated events when using the SSE streaming path (notably via the OpenAI-compat adapter). Root causes traced to: (1) incorrect delimiter handling when chunks split partial JSON tokens across payload boundaries, (2) event ordering regressions when buffering and flush scheduling interacted with concurrent writers, and (3) edge cases in the partial-JSON reassembly logic that led to spurious trailing delimiters. This PR makes the streaming framer and the OpenAI compatibility adapter robust to partial-token boundaries and preserves strict token/event ordering across chunking/flush boundaries.

Summary of changes: - server/sse/framer.go: rewritten chunk parsing to use a small state machine that tracks partial JSON tokens, explicit delimiter consumption, and stable ordering guarantees. Added comments documenting the state transitions. - server/sse/streaming.go: ensured write ordering via an ordered-queue write path when multiple goroutines enqueue chunks; removed opportunistic flushes that could re-order events. - client/openai_compat/streaming_adapter.go: updated adapter to emit well-formed SSE events even when underlying model tokenization yields split JSON fragments; added a per-stream reassembly buffer with bounded memory. - tests/framer_test.go & framer_fuzz_test.go: new unit tests and fuzz corpus for partial JSON boundaries, delimiter permutations, and interleaved small/large chunks. - docs/api/streaming.md: added a note describing guaranteed ordering and guidance for SDK maintainers. - sdk-js/src/stream.ts: small changes to the client-side reassembly logic to be tolerant of reordered chunk delivery as long as event ordering is preserved by the server.

Testing: Ran full CI (unit, integration, e2e streaming smoke) and added targeted fuzz tests. Simulated high-concurrency scenarios and validated no parse errors over 10k randomized sequences. QA ran integration tests against the OpenAI compatibility suite and verified no behavioral changes to the public API contract.

Rollout plan: merged to main, backport candidate branch 'release/2026-02' flagged with label backport-ready. No config changes required. Observability: added a metrics counter sse.framer.partial_tokens_handled (debug) and an alertable rate for sse.unexpected_parse_errors which is expected to drop to zero after rollout.

Notes and known limitations: This PR focuses on server-side ordering guarantees; client retries that replay partial streams may still observe duplicate events unless clients deduplicate by event id. We added guidance in docs and SDKs to help clients dedupe on consumer-facing ids.

Related: ENG-4123 (investigation), ENG-4198 (openai-compat follow-up), SUP-887 (customer ticket).

review_comments: Marco Reyes: Good diagnosis. Two asks: (1) please add a short explanation of the state machine invariants in code comments, (2) can we gate the ordered-queue behind a feature flag to measure perf impact?

Asha Patel (author): Added detailed comments and removed previously flaky opportunistic flush path. The ordered-queue is now behind a runtime flag 'sse.ordered_writes' (default: true) per Marco's suggestion so we can roll and measure.
Jordan Kim: Tests look solid. The fuzz corpus catches the issue we saw in the field. One nit: add a small benchmark to ensure no regression for 4k token streams.
Asha Patel: Added benchmark sse_bench/bench_ordered_writes_test.go and verified within noise vs previous implementation (0-3% overhead).
Lina Chen: Approved. Verified CI artifacts and e2e runs. Backport to release/2026-02 required.
Release Manager: Merged via squash. Backport ticket created: ENG-4205.
release_notes: Fix SSE streaming framing: resolves partial JSON delimiter and token ordering bugs that could cause JSON parse errors or truncated events in streaming responses. Improves streaming stability for OpenAI-compat clients. Backport to release/2026-02 planned.
notes: Observed customer impact: intermittent parse errors when using streaming + function-calling; this patch targets that regression.
Monitoring: watch sse.unexpected_parse_errors and sse.framer.partial_tokens_handled rates post-rollout.
Follow-ups: ENG-4198 to harden client deduplication guidance and ENG-4205 backport tracking.
